up: Retrieve distinct molecules referenced in the document identified by CHEMBL1123860. For each molecule, provide its ChEMBL identifier (molecule_chembl_id), compound name (pref_name from molecule_dictionary), and canonical SMILES (from compound_structures). Include only those molecules that have a non-null canonical SMILES. Order the results by molecule_chembl_id, compound name, and canonical SMILES, each in ascending order.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name AS compound_name, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1123860' AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL ORDER BY md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles;
